name: dream of the horror
source: In the combat school of Nightwake, Dream is a seemingly perfect athlete. He soon becomes entranced by a rebellious, lone girl surrounded by rumors and are brought together by their mutual desire for something more than this life.
translation: 在《夜醒》的战斗学校中，Dream是一位看似完美的运动员。他很快就被一个叛逆、孤独、被谣言包围的女孩所吸引，并因为他们对今生以外的东西的共同渴望而走到了一起。
